Kayros & Kamala

Corporate website for two eyewear brands.

Client
Kayros & Kamala (OpticalTrend SL)
Scope
Website redesign, SEO / GEO / AEO, AI visual content, email marketing

What I did

  • Designed and built the current Kayros & Kamala website. It is a redesign of the website the brands had before.
  • Built on WordPress, with structure and copy optimized for traditional search (SEO) and for AI-powered search and answer engines (GEO and AEO).
  • Visual direction follows the Kamala brand style, anticipating the plan to separate the site into two brand-specific websites.
  • Alongside the site: generative-AI visual content for brand communication, and email marketing content and campaigns through Brevo.

MZ Garage

New website, audit and CRM demo for a premium vehicle dealer.

Client
MZ Garage, vehicle sales in Sant Quirze del Vallès
Scope
Audit, new website, CRM demo

What I did

  • Audited the business’s online presence for SEO, GEO and AEO.
  • Created a complete new website from scratch: the company’s corporate colours on a clean white layout, with a UX/UI and SEO / GEO / AEO-driven structure.
  • The site includes a searchable vehicle listing with filters, a “sell your car” valuation flow, financing and warranty pages and buying guides.
  • Developed a custom CRM demo that classifies incoming enquiries and shows notifications.
  • Next phase: creating and optimizing the Google Business Profile listing, which the business did not have.

Sale e Pepe

Website for an Italian restaurant with two locations.

Client
Sale e Pepe, Italian restaurant in the Vallès
Scope
Website design and build, local SEO

What I did

  • Designed, built and published the website for a restaurant with two locations: Sant Quirze del Vallès and Cerdanyola del Vallès.
  • Designed around a real problem, customers mixing up the two locations: a location-selector landing page, location-specific colour themes, a persistent location banner, and address, phone, hours and map data kept separate per location.
  • Menu with an allergen filter, and a site structure built with local SEO in mind.
  • Prepared a local SEO checklist for the project.

About

I work on real projects for businesses and brands, from audits to complete websites, always focused on how a company shows up in search results and in AI-powered answers.

I’m Ivan, a student of the double degree in Business Administration and Marketing & Digital Communication at EUNCET Business School, graduating in 2027.
